cause_quote: In ui/src/components/tooltip-title.ts the title-hint suppression changed from `previewTargetForAnchor(link)` to `ownsHoverPreview(link)`, and the new `resolveHoverPreviewTarget` returns a page preview for any external http(s) link, so the hint nested in the ClawHub audit link was suppressed in favor of the page preview.
user_saw: Hovering the info icon next to "Security audit" on plugin and Template pages showed a link page preview instead of any explanation of the audit.
summary: Moved the security-audit info icon out of the audit link into its own tooltip button with explanatory copy, keeping the link on the verdict row.
reasoning: The `<span title="View security audit">` info hint inside the external audit link already existed at 8c7f96b00b4^ (security-audit.ts line 45), when title tooltips were suppressed only for plugin link-reader targets; #152758 extended hover previews to all ordinary external links and made tooltip-title defer to `ownsHoverPreview`, which hides nested title hints on those links. Medium confidence because the preview only applies when link previews (automaticallyFetchFavicons) are on and I did not run the UI; the fix also rewrote the hint copy, which is partly a content improvement.
